observed_failure: Final state requires actual reviewer, review date and evidence. A typed name is not authorization.
root_cause: Generic final-state validation required reviewer/review_date/evidence_ref, which are absent from native Punch schema.
fix: Punch Closed uses owner, verified_by, verification_date and closure_evidence_ref; separate declared verifier and at/before cutoff checks. Invalid imported closure is attention item.
evidence: Browser native Advanced Punch Closed save and future-date rejection
